Nora: All-hands in 25. Quick updates: were doing a camera swap at T-5 (main -> presenter room cam). If the presenter cam feed flaps, Ops will cut to the room cam and continue. Keep questions in #all-hands-questions.

Eli: Noted. Two asks: 1) can we record a local backup to the M.2 drive? 2) enable live captions via Otter.ai bridge if Zoom captions are unstable.

Sam: +1 on Otter.ai. Also request: set slide transition to fade (0.3s) to avoid jarring cut to video.

OpsBot: Stream health: CPU 28% | RTMP jitter 3ms | rec disk free 120GB. If RTMP fails, auto-fail to vMix direct ingest rtmp://y.live/altkey.

Nora: Pinned Q&A doc: https://docs.internal/all-hands/2026-05-qa. Add short follow-ups (1 sentence) and tag the owner.

Eli: Small tweak: if Otter disconnects, Matt will copy live chat into the doc for the backlog.

Clare: Thanks everyone. Quick rehearsal at T-6, real run at T-2. I'll open the floor for leadership questions at T+18. :hand:
